facts.fact: AfroAsia Media reports that the Bank of Ghana has extended PAPSS to mobile wallets on the Ghana-Nigeria corridor.

The Bank of Ghana is testing cross-border interoperability using central bank digital currencies, stablecoins, bank accounts and mobile wallets along the Ghana-Rwanda and Ghana-Nigeria corridors, per AfroAsia Media.
AfroAsia Media reports PAPSS has been extended to mobile wallets by the Bank of Ghana, which shows Ghana taking part in PAPSS.
